title: Object
description: The second backbone node of TRC's descent path -> object -> attribute -> file (mirroring voidmath's cell -> fiber -> presheaf -> sheaf). The object is the residue that reading a path leaves, predicated into the cellular fiber; per the README it corresponds to voidmath's fiber at the transfinite/predicate regime. This is a minimal type-witness for the node (its full structural content is the voidmath fiber it carries); deriving that structure on-disk is a separate task.
